hypotheses.justification: Split on v < n; the existing proof handles that case. Otherwise, hp.posSize and getElem!_neg give p.pos[v]! = 0. If n = 0, Refines is vacuous. If n > 0, hp.cstLe gives p.cst[0]! = 0. By individualize_cst_eq and setCstFrom_getElemD (using hp.cenLe and hp.cstSize), individualization changes only cst entries at 1 ≤ k < p.cen[0]!, setting them to 1. No such k was an old cell start: hp.cellCst at position 0 gives p.cst[k]! = 0, contradicting p.cst[k]! = k and k ≥ 1. All old cell starts therefore remain unchanged, proving Refines without hv.
